title: MRI of the lumbar spine for low back pain
sourceNote: Illustrative policy written for this portfolio demo.

criteria.text: Documented diagnosis of lumbar radiculopathy or low back pain.
criteria.guidance: Look for an assessment or diagnosis naming lumbar radiculopathy, sciatica or low back pain.

criteria.text: At least 6 weeks of conservative therapy (physical therapy, NSAIDs or activity modification) within the past 6 months.
criteria.guidance: Dates or durations of PT, medication trials or home exercise. Count weeks from the documented start date.

criteria.text: Objective neurologic finding on exam, or radicular symptoms that persist despite conservative therapy.
criteria.guidance: Positive straight-leg raise, dermatomal sensory loss, weakness or reflex change; or persistent leg pain after therapy.

criteria.text: No MRI of the lumbar spine in the prior 12 months.
criteria.guidance: Check the claims history for CPT 72148, 72149 or 72158 in the last 12 months.

title: Total knee arthroplasty
sourceNote: Illustrative policy written for this portfolio demo.

criteria.text: Radiographic evidence of advanced osteoarthritis (Kellgren-Lawrence grade 3 or 4) of the affected knee.
criteria.guidance: Imaging report naming KL grade 3 or 4, or bone-on-bone / severe joint-space narrowing.

criteria.text: At least 12 weeks of documented nonsurgical treatment (physical therapy, NSAIDs, injections, bracing or weight loss).
criteria.guidance: Dates or durations of each modality. Total the documented duration.

criteria.text: Pain or functional limitation that interferes with activities of daily living.
criteria.guidance: Statements about walking distance, stairs, work or self-care limits, or a functional score.

criteria.text: BMI below 40, or documented medical optimization if BMI is 40 or above.
criteria.guidance: Most recent BMI in the record.

criteria.text: No active infection in or around the knee.
criteria.guidance: Exam or history stating no infection, no open wounds, no fever.

title: Semaglutide (Wegovy) for chronic weight management
sourceNote: Illustrative policy written for this portfolio demo.

criteria.text: Member is 18 or older with BMI of 30 or above, or BMI of 27 or above with at least one weight-related condition (e.g. hypertension, dyslipidemia, type 2 diabetes).
criteria.guidance: Most recent BMI and the problem list.

criteria.text: Currently participating in a reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity program, documented by the prescriber.
criteria.guidance: A named program or a specific description of the diet and activity plan with a start date.

criteria.text: Not used together with another GLP-1 receptor agonist.
criteria.guidance: Pharmacy history and medication list for liraglutide, dulaglutide, tirzepatide or other semaglutide products.
